title: The colorful star cluster NGC 3532
caption: The open star cluster NGC 3532, imaged by the MPG/ESO 2.2-meter telescope at La Silla
celestial: NGC 3532 · constellation Carina · about 1300 light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Official ESO press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: Stars of contrasting colors fill this vivid view of NGC 3532, a bright star cluster. Some still shine with a hot bluish light, while many of the heavier ones have already swollen into red giants and glow a rich orange.

The difference tells a story about age. A star's color reflects its surface temperature, and the most massive stars run through their fuel fastest. In a cluster whose stars were born together, the heaviest ones are therefore the first to swell into cool red giants, while less massive stars carry on shining much as before.

NGC 3532 is an open cluster, a loose group of stars born together from the same cloud, lying about 1300 light-years away in the direction of Carina. The picture was captured with La Silla's MPG/ESO 2.2-meter telescope in Chile.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (34.34 x 33.19 arcminutes) and distance (1300 light years), the frame spans roughly 13 × 13 light-years. Its light set out about 1,300 years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: This image from the Wide Field Imager combines B, V, I and hydrogen-alpha filters, spanning visible light and the near-infrared. The color assigned to each filter isn't published.
understand.eye: Part of the light is near-infrared and invisible to the eye, and the long exposures show far more stars than the eye could see.

behind.exposure: Not published on the source page.
behind.technique: Not stated by the source (single frame, stack, mosaic or panorama unknown).

explore: The image combines exposures through B, V and I filters, reaching from visible light into the near-infrared, plus a hydrogen-alpha filter that isolates the red glow of hydrogen gas in the field.
alt: A bright star cluster of bluish and orange stars.
